commands.name: dependencies
commands.command: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt -r agent/requirements.txt && npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund

commands.name: windows_exe
commands.command: python -m pip install -r agent/requirements.txt pyinstaller && python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onefile --windowed --name RemoteDeskPro-V2 agent/host_agent.py
